title: Vineyard registry skillpack entry
description: One row in community-skillpacks.json. LEAN catalog projection: the full playbook (overview + sections) lives in the author repo at repo@ref/path; derived fields let the browse page render without fetching every manifest. A skillpack is TEXT (an investigation playbook the agent may consult) — it runs no code and requests no permissions of its own; its only dependency surface is the pluginpacks its steps call, declared in `requires`.

identifier.description: Reverse-DNS PK; equals the skill manifest.identifier. Unique across the whole registry. The namespace is the AUTHOR'S OWN reverse-DNS prefix, two labels or more: `run.vineyard.*` is first-party, a third party publishes under its own (`com.acme.*`, `io.github.someone.*`). Claiming a namespace you do not control is a review question, not a schema one.

description.description: <=250 chars, sentence case, ends with a period, no emoji.

repo.description: owner/name GitHub path hosting the skill document.

ref.description: IMMUTABLE commit SHA of the content repo, captured at PR time. Tags/branches are mutable and REJECTED — pin the exact reviewed commit so the catalog can never serve different playbook text.

path.description: Path to the skill JSON within repo@ref.

version.description: SemVer mirror of the skill's version at this ref.

applies_to.description: DERIVED: node types (category.name) the playbook is about — its subject, shown on the card.

section_count.description: DERIVED: number of sections the playbook holds (progressive-disclosure leaves).

requires.description: Pluginpack identifiers the playbook's steps call. The marketplace offers these for co-install and gates availability on them; an empty/absent list means the skill leans on built-in tools only.

verified.description: Mirror of verified-authors.json membership; set by CI, not self-asserted.
